PityFlowerDesc:
When Mario takes damage,
occasionally recover 1FP.
JumpmanDesc:
Increase jump power by 1, but
lose your hammer ability.
HammermanDesc:
Increase hammer power by 1
but lose the ability to jump.
FPDrainDesc:
Drop Mario's Attack power by
1 but regain 1 FP per attack.
CourageShellDesc:
Boost your defense by
3 for three turns.
PowerPunchDesc:
Boost your attack power by
2 for three turns.
MiniMrMiniDesc:
Briefly shrinks enemies,
dropping their Attack power.
MrSoftenerDesc:
Softens up enemies for a bit,
decreasing their Defense.
SlowShroomDesc:
Gradually recover HP for
a brief period.
GradualSyrupDesc:
Gradually recover FP for
a brief period.
CouplesCakeDesc:
Food that slowly refills HP.
You can't eat it alone.
MeteorMealDesc:
Food that refills 7 HP and
gradually recovers even more.
ModeTTYD64Desc: Partner HP and new battle rules.
